description:
About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager, Offers & Loyalty Partnerships, you will own a high-visibility offers and loyalty product area that we build and run with large financial-institution partners, setting the product direction, running the roadmap and being accountable for outcomes for consumers, merchants and partners. This is a hard product problem spanning relevance and personalization, marketplace economics, measurement and partner-grade reliability under strict compliance requirements, and we want a rigorous, classically strong product manager who works AI-natively and has a clear point of view on where AI belongs in the product itself. In your first year you'll be judged on what you ship and what it earns: measurable growth in engagement, redemptions and incremental revenue against targets agreed with our partners.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for offers and loyalty, prioritizing against business outcomes and owning what ships and what it earns

  • Run the partner relationship at the product level, working with partner product, technology, loyalty and risk teams on scope, integration, security reviews and ongoing operations

  • Own the core mechanics: targeting, ranking, measurement and the economics that balance value for consumers, merchants and partners

  • Shape the consumer experience across discovery, engagement and redemption, treating trust, clarity and relevance as product requirements

  • Decide where AI creates real value (personalization, ranking, merchant tooling, analytics and internal operations) and ship it with proper evaluation and guardrails

  • Define the metrics, run experiments, build your own analyses and decide from evidence

  • Align engineering, data science, design, sales and legal behind a clear plan, and communicate trade-offs crisply to executives and partners

  • Write sharp specs, decision memos and partner-facing documents that are short, precise and easy to act on

An ideal candidate has

  • 8+ years of product management experience owning complex, high-stakes products from strategy through delivery and iteration; experience in loyalty, rewards, payments, offers or promotions platforms is a plus

  • Experience with B2B2C, platform or marketplace products that serve several parties at once (consumers, merchants and partners)

  • Enough technical depth to read an API spec, reason about data flows and system trade-offs, and earn the respect of senior engineers; familiarity with ML-driven ranking or recommendation systems and how they are evaluated is a plus

  • Sound commercial judgment on unit economics, pricing and how product design drives a partner's P&L; a background in ad tech or performance marketing, especially targeting and measurement, is a plus

  • Experience working with large enterprise partners, ideally financial institutions, where security, risk, privacy and compliance shape the roadmap

  • Daily use of AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, writing and synthesis, with concrete examples of how that changed what you shipped and how fast, and a considered view of where AI helps and where it doesn't in a regulated setting; experience shipping AI features in production is a plus

  • A track record of leading without authority: you can say no, explain why, and keep executives, engineers and partners aligned when a partner pushes hard

  • Senior and self-directed; you bring a clear point of view to leadership, and you prototype before you write the doc when it's faster

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

  • 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees

  • Access to Disability & Life insurance

  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)

  • DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, provide AI-driven travel technology solutions to travelers across 172 countries around the globe. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary models to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same.

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Via our B2B division, HTS, we work with the world's leading banks, airlines and travel providers, including Capital One, Frontier, Wizz Air, Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Nubank, and more, supercharging their direct channels with HTS’ travel fintech, AI, loyalty and e-commerce products.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the infrastructure powering travel technology for brands globally

What that looks like in practice:

  • Hopper and its B2B division, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions) are growing quickly; the company sells billions in travel and travel fintech every year.

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.

  • The Hopper consumer channels have garnered 120M+ app downloads.

  • Our B2B business, HTS reaches 877M+ cardholders through global bank partnerships and $4.2T in card spend.

  • Hopper’s B2B business sells travel fintech in 172 countries, and 400M travelers are exposed to our fintech products every year.

  • HTS Assist, our agentic AI customer service solution, is live with several partners. It has handled 1M trips end-to-end at 92% lower cost per conversation than a human agent.

  • HTS Media & Offers connects travel brands, destinations and merchants with travelers at the moment they plan, book and pay. For our partners, it means new revenue and more engaged customers. For travelers, it means offers that are relevant to the trip they’re actually taking.

Come take off with us!


#LI-Remote

While this role utilizes automated systems to assess candidate suitability, every actionable decision is made by a human member of our team. Under local regulations, you have the right to understand the principal factors used in this assessment, request a correction of your data, or request a human review of any automated decision. To exercise these rights, please contact recruiting@hopper.com
